versions.changelog: Add timed-task duration compliance and universal actionable lesson quality gate

Initial release of memory-driven-execution-loop.

- Enables autonomous operation using explicit external memory files.
- Processes tasks via a step-by-step execution loop with continuous state updates.
- Maintains six core files: rules, goal, plan, progress, notes, and lessons.
- Integrates a structured “lesson quality gate” to improve learning from failures.
